## Assignment 

R has three assignment operators: 

- `->`,
- `=`, and  
- `<-`

```{r assignments}
x1 = 5
5 -> x2
x3 = 7


cat("The valiue of x1:", x1)

```

## Atomic Vectors 

Atomic vectors are 1D data dtructures, where all values in them have to have the same data type. For example, if we do the following: 

```{r atomic}
mixed_vec = c('ISA', 401)

mixed_num = c(401L,23)

print(typeof(mixed_num))
print(typeof(mixed_vec))
```
From this output, if you have multiple data types, R will use the most recent representation of them.
